Contamos con más de 29,000 mil empleados, más de 150 centros de distribución y 30 plantas.




En México operamos bajo el nombre de Grupo Peñafiel, haciendo referencia a nuestra marca más representativa para los consumidores mexicanos, con más de 70 años de historia. description:
About the job

About The Role

The Revenue Marketing team is responsible for generating and accelerating the pipeline that grows Shopify's business with mid-market and upmarket merchants. We're looking for a Senior Lead, Demand & Digital Field Marketing to create demand across AMER Sales Segments.

You will be the marketing counterpart of our sales leaders rely on: the person who turns their territory priorities into programs that produce qualified pipeline. You'll lead the strategy on sales play, signals, and digital field programs. That means a quarterly play calendar built against real opportunity types (new logo, expansion, competitive displacement, closed-lost win-back), buying signals actioned into outreach that reps actually run, and a portfolio of virtual events, webinars, gifting, and incentive programs that create demand.

You'll partner with Growth Marketing on targeted campaigns so the top of the funnel and the plays underneath it point at the same accounts.

We're looking for a leader who is equally comfortable in a territory review with sales leaders and demand programs. You set the bar for execution quality, and you're measured on quality pipeline. Your key KPIs are inbound and outbound Sales Accepted Leads (count and value), in alignment with the AMER sales team's targets.

Key Responsibilities:


Responsible for the AMER sales play system: build the quarterly play calendar against pipeline targets,land it with sales leadership, and execute to drive pipeline
Own pipeline generation numbers in Sales forecast calls and be able to translate Marketing-led programs into pipeline impact
Equip reps with plays they will actually run: clear positioning, ready-to-send outreach, supporting content, and a defined follow-up motion
Turn product, account, and intent signals into prioritized outreach and campaign triggers, and define which signals matter most to action
Partner with sales and funnel operations on routing, follow-up SLAs, and speed to lead so signals convert instead of aging
Own our digital-first field portfolio: virtual events, executive roundtables, webinars built as demand programs, gifting and incentive programs, and activations around major industry moments
Partner with Growth Marketing on targeted campaigns and paid programs that reach priority accounts and feed consistent, quality pipeline
Report performance to marketing and sales leadership weekly in a form that drives decisions, and build measurement into every program before it launches
Put AI agents and tooling to work on program build, reporting, and campaign production. 



Qualifications


Strong track record of building demand or field marketing programs that hit pipeline and revenue targets in B2B SaaS, ecommerce, or technology
Direct experience partnering with sales leaders as a peer. Bring a strong spirit of collaboration and “win together” attitude
Demonstrated ownership of Sales pipeline and programs, including sales plays or account-based programs
Experience running virtual events, webinars, and executive programs as pipeline vehicles, with clear before-and-after numbers
Strong analytical skills. You're fluent in funnel and pipeline data, can interrogate a dashboard, and can design an experiment with a hypothesis and a kill criterion
Working knowledge of the modern marketing and CRM stack (marketing automation, CRM, intent and signal data, campaign attribution)
Excellent written and verbal communication. You can compress a complicated program into a paragraph a sales leader will read
Keen interest in AI and a habit of putting agents and tools to work on your own programs, reporting, and production
Resilient and resourceful in the face of ambiguity, and able to thrive on change rather than endure it
Strong understanding of the ecommerce market, mid-market merchant needs, and the competitive set



About Shopify

Opportunity is not evenly distributed. Shopify puts independence within reach for anyone with a dream to start a business. We propel entrepreneurs and enterprises to scale the heights of their potential. Since 2006, we’ve grown to over 8,300 employees and generated over $1 trillion in sales for millions of merchants in 175 countries.

This is life-defining work that directly impacts people’s lives as much as it transforms your own. This is putting the power of the few in the hands of the many, is a future with more voices rather than fewer, and is creating more choices instead of an elite option.

About You

Moving at our pace brings a lot of change, complexity, and ambiguity—and a little bit of chaos. Shopifolk thrive on that and are comfortable being uncomfortable. That means Shopify is not the right place for everyone.

Before you apply, consider if you can:


Care deeply about what you do and about making commerce better for everyone
Excel by seeking professional and personal hypergrowth
Keep up with an unrelenting pace (the week, not the quarter)
Be resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on (rather than endure) change
Bring critical thought and opinion
Put AI agents and tools to work on the tasks they're built for, and focus on the work only humans can do
Embrace differences and disagreement to get shit done and move forward
Work digital-first for your daily work

You are a creative and audience-focused communicator with a passion for visual storytelling, social media, and digital engagement. You enjoy experimenting with different formats, identifying creative ways to communicate ideas, and producing content that connects with audiences.

Plan A Technologies is a global engineering firm created to solve the toughest tech challenges facing today’s businesses. Founded by software entrepreneurs Aron Ezra and Slav Kulik, Plan A helps organizations analyze their tech ecosystem to identify exactly what needs to be improved across their products and infrastructure—and then builds the solutions to fix it.

About the job

About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

The CX Operations Analyst will play a key role in building the foundation of Customer Experience analytics at Crunchyroll. This position will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing operational dashboards and reporting solutions that provide visibility into contact center performance, customer health, and emerging trends.

Initially, the role will focus heavily on Tableau and Salesforce reporting, supporting stakeholders across Customer Experience, Operations, Product, and Business teams. Over time, this position will evolve into a broader CX Analytics role with opportunities to perform advanced analysis, identify drivers of customer behavior, uncover root causes of customer friction, and influence strategic business decisions.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys solving business problems with data and wants to grow from reporting and visualization into advanced analytics and customer insights.

What You'll Do

Dashboarding & Reporting


Design, develop, and maintain Tableau dashboards that provide real-time and historical visibility into contact center operations and customer experience performance.
Build and support Salesforce dashboards and reports used by CX leadership and operational teams.
Create scalable reporting solutions that deliver consistent, trusted metrics across the organization.
Monitor dashboard performance, data quality, and reporting reliability.


CX Operations Insights


Analyze customer support performance metrics including contact volume, service levels, response times, customer satisfaction, resolution rates, and agent productivity.
Identify trends, anomalies, and operational opportunities that improve customer outcomes and efficiency.
Partner with CX leaders to define KPIs and establish measurement frameworks.
Translate complex data into clear business recommendations and executive-ready visualizations.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Work closely with Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, Data, and Business Intelligence teams to improve access to customer data and insights.
Gather stakeholder requirements and translate business questions into analytical solutions.
Support recurring business reviews with reporting, insights, and recommendations.


Future Growth into Advanced Analytics


Develop deeper analytical capabilities around customer behavior, retention, support effectiveness, and customer journey optimization.
Perform root cause analysis to identify drivers of customer issues and support demand.
Contribute to predictive and prescriptive analytics initiatives as the CX Analytics function evolves.
Help build a culture of data-driven decision making across Customer Experience.


Required Qualifications

What We're Looking For


Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, operations analysis, customer experience, or related roles.
Experience building dashboards and reports in Tableau.
Experience working with Salesforce reporting and dashboards.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational datasets.
Ability to communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience supporting customer service, contact center, or customer experience organizations.
Experience with customer support platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Zendesk, or similar systems.
Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and modern analytics ecosystems.
Experience performing statistical analysis, experimentation, forecasting, or customer behavior analysis.
Knowledge of Python, R, or other analytical programming languages.
Experience working with large-scale customer datasets.


What Makes Someone Successful In This Role


You are naturally curious and enjoy digging beneath the surface to understand why things happen.
You balance technical expertise with business understanding.
You can build trusted reporting while also uncovering meaningful insights.
You are comfortable moving between operational details and strategic questions.
You are excited by the opportunity to grow from dashboard development into advanced customer analytics.

About Our Values

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value


Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.

About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

A key unit within the Strategy & Planning (S&P) function, the Fintech Strategy team is small and highly selective. It is made up of highly accomplished professionals with backgrounds in technology, management consulting, and investment banking. It has a central role in helping our top leaders answer their most pressing questions and support their most impactful decisions. Our team partners directly with senior stakeholders based in China, to frame problems, structure thinking, conduct research, and generate insights that drive high-impact decisions across DiDi Fintech in Mexico and, increasingly, the broader LatAm region. Members of this team share an endless sense of curiosity and are able to turn raw data into valuable knowledge and actionable insights. Our team works on strategic initiatives that shape our product roadmap, market positioning, and long-term growth, connecting on-the-ground realities in Mexico with the priorities of our global headquarters in China. The team is focused on the future, delegating the execution of plans to local operational teams while they're already looking forward to what will come after, working several steps ahead, to establish a path forward.

In this role, you'll be...


Exposed to influential leaders and learn how decision-making happens in the highest levels of corporate strategy.
 As a Strategy Intern you'll be monitoring the competitive landscape to identify emerging threats and opportunities, exploring new markets and product verticals, and serving as our “eyes on the ground” for Mexico’s evolving macroeconomic environment and regulatory context.
The work is dynamic and evolves with the needs of the business, requiring a proactive and adatable mindset.
You’ll help DiDi’s leadership in China and Mexico understand where to play and how to win, translating local dynamics into clear, data-driven recommendations while being attentive to cultural nuances and strategic implications.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


A background in finance or economics, and a curious mind paired with a strong analytical toolkit to match it.
You enjoy digging into data, markets, and regulation to uncover insights, and you can structure complex problems into clear, actionable reports.
You are an intelectual with an interest in finance and the economy, and a collaborative team player who thrives in fast-paced, cross-cultural environments, and you communicate in concise, well-structured written English.
You care about details, whether in a model, a slide, or a short memo, because you understand that precision and clarity are essential when advising senior leaders on high-stakes decisions.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

Ready to accelerate your career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.

We're building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

We're looking for a Product Lead, Verticals (Core Cards & Stablecoins) to join our Core Cards Processing team and sit at the heart of Clara's payment infrastructure. In this role, you will work on high-impact initiatives across strategic verticals—including Travel, Fleet, Corporate Cards, and stablecoin-powered payment flows. You will partner directly with card processors, network partners (Mastercard), and internal software engineering teams to build and scale core issuing capabilities, card lifecycles, clearing, settlement, and stablecoin payment rails while shipping fast using AI tools as a daily multiplier.


Drive the evolution of Clara's card processing infrastructure: issuing, card flows, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, and payment applications. 
Own product discovery and execution for stablecoin-powered payment flows integrated into Clara's corporate card infrastructure, navigating regulatory and technical nuances for cross-border payments. 
Partner with business teams to translate vertical-specific needs (Travel, Fuel/Fleet, Corporate Cards) into durable core platform capabilities rather than one-off features. 
Prototype, validate, and ship concepts faster using AI tools, contributing code via Github for configuration changes, copy, feature flags, and simple UI updates to keep momentum moving. 
Collaborate closely with Engineering, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and external network providers to turn complex operational and business problems into structured, shippable product solutions. 
Define, prioritize, and track core platform metrics, using data-driven insights with tools like Metabase to inform long-term roadmap planning and execution. 


Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Working proficiency in English and Spanish. 
5+ years in product management, product engineering, or a hybrid building role, with a track record of shipping products that directly move core business metrics. 
Hands-on experience with stablecoins, crypto payment rails, or blockchain-based settlement systems (e.g., USDC, USDT, or on-chain payment flows). 
Strong domain exposure to fintech, financial infrastructure, card issuing, or payment flows with networks like Mastercard or Visa. 
Technical fluency with web architecture concepts and hands-on comfort using Github workflows (cloning repos, creating branches, pushing commits, reading diffs). 
Experience or interest in AI tools to automate workflows, validate ideas, and prototype products quickly before committing core engineering bandwidth. 
Strong data literacy with experience writing SQL, working with dashboards, and evaluating cohort analytics. 
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a track record of driving cross-functional alignment through clear written documentation. 
Adaptability to fast-changing environments, bringing high agency and a builder mindset. 


Nice to haves


Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it. 
Familiarity with Latin American regulatory and compliance nuances surrounding crypto payments, stablecoins, and card issuing across MX, CO, or BR. 
Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL, or Python to build custom data models and evaluate metrics. 
A good sense of humor. 


Why join Clara

At Clara, you'll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are


We're the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America. 
Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup. 
Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. 
Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. 
Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. 
Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. 


What we believe in


#Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively. 
#Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters. 
#Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told. 
#Pride. We build products and experiences we're proud of. 
#Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action.

What we offer


Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one 
Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language) 
Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths 
High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together 
Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact 
Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results 


If you're ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara's Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

description:
About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.


What We Offer

Our benefits package includes …


Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
Employee Assistance Program
Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!


Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

About the job

Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

Job Description

We are presently looking for a Senior Customer Care Specialist to provide day-to-day support to new and existing customers. In this position, the lead will monitor and mentor a team of customer care specialists and assist with workload and escalation activities. Activities require working with internal cross-functional technical groups and external customers business and engineering teams to drive successful delivery of customer implementations and proactively ensure the on-going success of customer accounts.

Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership & Mentorship: Monitor daily queue management, assist with workload distribution in Salesforce/Zendesk, and mentor team members to support department performance and skill development.
Account & Stakeholder Management: Serve as the main point of contact and Subject Matter Expert (SME) for key customer accounts, leading client meetings and cross-functional collaborations with Sales and Technical teams.
Technical Support & Escalations: Diagnose, troubleshoot, and prioritize complex product issues, effectively escalating critical problems to internal engineering and technical staff when necessary.
Process & Project Management: Coordinate special projects, maintain detailed documentation (agendas, minutes, action items), and participate in on-call support rotation to ensure seamless 24/7 coverage.


Qualifications


Associates or Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline
Degree in a technical discipline with 5+ years of customer-facing experience leading accounts, handling escalations, and using tools like Salesforce, Zendesk, and Google/Microsoft Suites (multilingual skills in French or Portuguese a plus).
Basic knowledge of custom software applications used at the Gracenote Queensbury NY office is helpful.
French and or Portuguese language skills are a plus.


Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Nielsen is committed to maintaining a work environment free from any form of discrimination and harassment. Nielsen prohibits conduct that has the purpose or effect of interfering with terms or conditions of employment, or that creates an intimidating, hostile, or offensive work environment based on: race, skin color/national or ethnic origin/ancestry, religion/creed, physical or mental disability/medical condition/genetic information, pregnancy, marital status, sex/gender, gender identity/gender expression/sexual orientation, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

At Nielsen, we promote equal opportunities for all individuals and value a diverse and inclusive workplace.

description:
About the job

Description

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to join the Amazon Payments Mexico marketing team. In this role, you will serve as the single-threaded owner of marketing execution for one or more payment products within the Amazon Mexico ecosystem. You will be responsible for converting marketing strategy into customer-facing outcomes through hands-on, week-by-week execution across onsite merchandising, promotions, performance reporting, and competitive intelligence.

This is a high-ownership, high-velocity role where you will manage the full execution lifecycle — from campaign creation and promotional configuration to post-campaign analysis — operating within Amazon's rigorous weekly business review cadence.

Key job responsibilities

Onsite Merchandising

Own all customer-facing placements on Amazon.com.mx including Maple campaigns (High Upsell Cards, Mobile View Cards, Priceblock banners, Wallet placements), DPIC content, Sparkle keyword campaigns, homepage hero banners, and landing pages

Manage creative briefing, review, scheduling coordination, and multi-channel QA across mobile, app, and desktop

Execute large-scale campaign rotations during High-Velocity Events (40+ onsite campaigns and 5–8 landing pages per event)

Configure targeting by card issuer and customer segment

Promotions & Discounts

Design promotional strategies for assigned payment products and navigate approval workflows with Finance and Legal

Configure promotions in relevant systems (PAWS, IBD coupon architecture, cashback configurations)

Coordinate with up to 14 issuing bank partners on offer structures, communication timing, and shared funding

Maintain a rolling pipeline of promotions planned quarters ahead and deliver post-promotion ROI reporting

Monitoring & Reporting

Produce weekly flash reports, WBR/MBR data pulls, and monthly deep-dive analyses

Maintain dashboards, detect anomalies, and deliver post-campaign performance reports and QBR inputs

Provide the feedback loop that determines campaign effectiveness, segment conversion, and budget efficiency

Competitive Intelligence

Conduct monthly structured competitive scans covering MercadoLibre, Liverpool, Coppel, major issuing banks, and emerging fintechs

Track feature launches, promotional mechanics, pricing changes, onsite merchandising tactics, and media spend shifts

Deliver intel summaries to the broader team and product partners

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Documentation

Write campaign briefs, BRDs, 1-pagers, and post-mortem narratives

Participate in weekly syncs with product managers, agency partners, legal/compliance reviews, and team ceremonies

Operate within Amazon's written communication culture and weekly business review cadence

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 8+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English
 3+ years of stakeholder management experience
 +8 YOE using data and metrics to drive improvements


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis


Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. description:
About the job

Company Description

At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients.

Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es

Why join us?

📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference.

📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on.

✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success.

Job Description

Docplanner's Paid Marketing team - a B2B function focused on acquiring doctors and clinics - is looking for a Senior Specialist in Creative Strategy & Performance to own the full creative lifecycle for paid media: from strategy and briefing, through asset production management, to performance intelligence and testing. This is a hybrid strategist/operator role - half creative thinking, half process and data discipline.

You'll be the bridge between performance data and creative output - turning what's working (and what isn't) across our nine markets into sharper briefs, faster production cycles, and a continuously improving testing roadmap.

We are looking for a person with a Performance Marketing background that has hands-on experience in campaigns management and targets delivery. If you are a performance marketer who loves testing and can turn insights into repeatable creative performance, read on!

How will you make an impact?

Creative Strategy


Define the creative strategy and testing roadmap for paid campaigns across all markets and ad platforms, aligned with performance goals
Translate campaign objectives and audience insights into clear, actionable briefs
Partner with local market teams to adapt global creative direction to local nuances - language, culture, and regulatory requirements


Asset Preparation & Coordination


Own the end-to-end production workflow: brief - content and design coordination - review - localization - trafficking
Coordinate with in-house designers and freelancers to keep timelines predictable
Build and maintain a repeatable process - briefing templates, naming conventions, approval workflows - to reduce bottlenecks and rework


Creative Intelligence & Testing


Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across Meta and other paid channels, defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test cadence
Build creative performance reporting (Meta Ads, Tableau, Amplitude) that identifies which elements - format, hook, messaging, visual style - drive results
Maintain a creative intelligence repository documenting what's worked, by market and format, to inform future briefs


Tracking & Measurement


Ensure creative-level tracking is implemented and tagged correctly, in partnership with the tracking/tech team, so performance can be attributed accurately
Monitor creative fatigue and flag refresh cycles proactively, before performance declines


Team Flexibility


Step into hands-on campaign management when needed - covering colleagues' absences or supporting new market initiatives.


What We're Looking For


4+ years in performance marketing with a proven track record in creative strategy, or a media buying background with hands-on experience in paid social creative (Meta Ads required; TikTok, Google, LinkedIn, or Bing a plus)
Hands-on experience in paid media performance, including campaign set-up and management - able to step into hands-on campaign management when team capacity is stretched
Demonstrated experience managing creative production across multiple stakeholders - designers, agencies, local teams - at scale
Strong analytical skills - comfortable pulling and interpreting creative performance data independently, not relying on assumptions
Experience designing and running structured creative tests, not ad hoc experimentation
Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills - this role touches Paid Ads, Design, Local Marketing, and Data Analytics teams
Fluent English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese a strong plus given our market footprint
Comfortable operating across multiple markets and cultures simultaneously


Nice to Have


Familiarity with Amplitude, Tableau, or HubSpot or Creative Intelligence tools
Experience with creative automation or dynamic creative optimization (DCO) tools
Background in healthcare, marketplace, or subscription business models


What To Expect From Our Hiring Process

We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role):

1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner, to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation.

2️⃣TestGorilla – (SHL numerical reasoning assessment).

3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience with the hiring manager and your potential manager in this role. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind—it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too.

4️⃣Business Case – A take-home exercise incl. a few days' preparation time, designed to understand how you approach real-life problems. You’ll then walk us through your approach in a collaborative discussion with the hiring manager and the team to discuss your thoughts and findings.

5️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview (Optional) – A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team.

6️⃣ References & Offer!

Why You’ll Love It Here

💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to:


Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters.
Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered.
Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance.


📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave.

🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects.

🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment.

⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna.

Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role.

What We Believe In

At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do:

📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact.

🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes.

✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity.

🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust.

📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job.

Don’t just take our word for it—check out our Glassdoor to hear what our people say!

_________________________________________________________________________

We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of gender, disability, or background, and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.

About the job

About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

An urban oasis in the heart of the city. Set around a verdant inner courtyard, our hacienda-style Hotel puts the hectic urban hustle of Mexico’s vibrant capital city seemingly on pause, but only for as long as you’d like. Step outside our doors, and you’ll find yourself on the grand boulevard of Paseo de la Reforma, just a short stroll away from Bosque de Chapultepec and the trendy neighbourhoods of Condesa and Polanco. Want to know what makes Mexico City tick? Join us at Fifty Mils, one of the 50 Best Bars of the world, and taste the cocktails that are captivating Mexico City.

Únete a nuestro equipo diverso y talentoso de Four Seasons Hotel Ciudad de México, 

Construido en torno a un idílico jardín con rayos de luz que permite que se refleje el brillo de los colores mexicanos, resaltando cada espacio que permiten un viaje de inspiración descubriendo como interactuar con la naturaleza poniendo en pausa al ruido, con una ubicación privilegiada, sobre el elegante Paseo de la Reforma y a metros del Bosque Chapultepec y del Museo de Arte Moderno. Obtenga más información sobre Four Seasons Hotel Ciudad de México,

El rol de “Digital Marketing Manager”

Liderar la presencia digital del hotel, mejorando la visibilidad de la marca e impulsando el compromiso a través de campañas digitales innovadoras y estrategias basadas en datos. Esta función es esencial para dar forma a la narrativa online del hotel, garantizar la coherencia en todas las plataformas digitales y apoyar los objetivos comerciales. El Director de Marketing Digital colaborará estrechamente con el Director de Marketing, el Director de Relaciones Públicas y los equipos de Ventas y Marketing para alinear las iniciativas digitales con los objetivos comerciales generales del hotel.

Responsabilidades Del Puesto


Desarrollar y ejecutar una estrategia digital basada en resultados en todas las plataformas digitales, incluidas SEO, PPC, redes sociales de pago y marketing por correo electrónico (LMLM). Implementar campañas innovadoras que mejoren el conocimiento de la marca, impulsen las reservas y apoyen los objetivos de ingresos. 
Gestionar y optimizar el sitio web del hotel, FS.com, la aplicación Four Seasons y los sitios asociados, garantizando que el contenido sea relevante, esté alineado con los estándares de la marca y optimizado para el rendimiento de los motores de búsqueda. 
Supervisar y gestionar todos los canales de redes sociales del hotel, incluyendo la creación de contenidos, la gestión de la comunidad y las asociaciones con personas influyentes. Desarrollar un calendario de contenido atractivo y supervisar la participación para garantizar un rendimiento óptimo. 
Colaborar con los equipos de operaciones para impulsar la captura de datos de los huéspedes, aumentar el uso de la aplicación Four Seasons y fomentar las reseñas en línea de los huéspedes. 
Curar y supervisar fotos, vídeos y recursos creativos de alta calidad para su uso en canales digitales y sociales, garantizando la coherencia con la identidad de marca y la narrativa de Four Seasons. 
Supervisar y responder a los comentarios de los huéspedes en plataformas como TripAdvisor, Google Reviews y otros canales clave. Proporcionar información y análisis de opiniones a las partes interesadas internas para mejorar la experiencia de los huéspedes. 
Colaborar con el Director de Revenue Management para optimizar las estrategias digitales que impulsan el retorno de la inversión y mejoran el proceso de reserva de los huéspedes. 
Apoyar al Director de Relaciones Públicas en la ejecución de iniciativas integradas de relaciones públicas, redes sociales y marketing de influencers. 
Utilizar herramientas de análisis como Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics y otras plataformas para realizar un seguimiento de los principales indicadores clave de rendimiento, generar informes mensuales de rendimiento y perfeccionar las estrategias digitales en función de los datos obtenidos. 
Gestionar y coordinar la producción fotográfica y de vídeo para las necesidades de marketing, redes sociales y relaciones públicas, garantizando que todos los activos reflejen el posicionamiento de lujo del hotel. 
Gestionar las relaciones con las agencias de medios digitales y supervisar la implementación de campañas, la asignación de presupuestos y los informes de rendimiento. 


Experiencia


Mínimo de 2 años de experiencia en marketing digital, estrategia de redes sociales o un puesto relacionado, preferiblemente en marcas de hostelería de lujo o estilo de vida. 
Capacidad demostrada para impulsar la participación y los ingresos a través de canales digitales.

Conocimiento profundo de las plataformas de medios sociales, estrategias de contenido y gestión de relaciones con personas influyentes. Éxito demostrado en el crecimiento de las comunidades de medios sociales y en la promoción de la marca. 
Excepcionales habilidades organizativas con capacidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente, cumplir plazos y adaptarse a un entorno de trabajo dinámico.

Gran orientación al detalle y pasión por mantener la coherencia y la calidad de la marca en todos los aspectos de la creación digital y de contenidos.

Habilidades de gestión del tiempo 
Vender a través de correo electrónico y de persona a persona 
Habilidades de desarrollo de la relación 
Gestión de ingresos y análisis de negocio utilizando plataformas y metodologías de marca

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts: 

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO desde 1998 entre las "100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo. 

 

Cultura de servicio 

Operando hoteles, resorts, y propiedades residenciales en los principales centros urbanos y destinos turísticos en más de 47 países, y con diferentes proyectos en planificación o desarrollo, Four Seasons se ubica constantemente entre los mejores hoteles del mundo y las marcas más prestigiosas en las encuestas de lectores, críticas de viajeros y premios de la industria. Nuestro mayor activo, y la clave de nuestro éxito, es nuestra gente.

About Our Client

Our client is a growing Silicon Valley-based technology company with an international team and a strong presence in the networking and technology space. They are looking for a senior, hands-on marketing professional who can take ownership of their content and digital marketing initiatives and become a key member of the team.

This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys being a “marketing army of one,” taking ownership, bringing creative ideas to life, and working closely with technical and sales teams to translate complex topics into compelling marketing content.

The ideal candidate is a creative, proactive, hands-on marketer who can develop content strategies, create and coordinate high-quality video content, manage the company website, produce written content, and support webinars and other marketing initiatives.

You will work closely with internal subject matter experts, sales engineers, and technical teams to turn complex technology topics into engaging content for customers and prospects. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who enjoys thinking strategically while also getting things done.




Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute a content strategy across the company’s key digital channels.

About the job

About Energy Exemplar

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation. 

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.
Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.
IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners
Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category
Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change
Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.

How We Work

Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

 

About the Position

As an Energy Market Analyst at Energy Exemplar, you will play a pivotal role in supporting customers from initial discovery to final sign-off. Your responsibilities will include understanding customer pain points, consulting on requirements, tailoring platform demos, and designing deployment strategies that align with their priorities.

The ideal candidate will provide expert guidance and support to our clients on best practices and current trends within LATAM power markets, leveraging technical modelling skills.

Identify key customer needs and requirements, success metrics, and process gaps through comprehensive discovery sessions.

title: Account Manager
description:
About the job

Buscamos Account Manager – Mid Level 




En Amazing buscamos a una persona resolutiva, estratégica, organizada y con actitud positiva, que quiera crecer y ayudar a llevar las cuentas de nuestros clientes al siguiente nivel. No buscamos un perfil de gestión genérica, sino a alguien con visión de negocio, sensibilidad creativa y capacidad de conectar los objetivos del cliente con soluciones eficaces. 

 




Lo que harás en tu día a día 




• Serás el punto de contacto principal de tus clientes, construyendo relaciones de confianza y entendiendo a fondo su negocio. 




• Traducirás sus necesidades en briefings claros y eficaces para el equipo interno. 




• Coordinarás a los equipos de estrategia, media, data y contenido para asegurar una ejecución alineada, ágil y de calidad. 




• Presentarás resultados y propuestas con foco estratégico, impacto visual y orientación a negocio. 




• Harás seguimiento de KPIs y activarás mejoras cuando sea necesario. 




• Detectarás oportunidades de crecimiento dentro de las cuentas y colaborarás en su planteamiento comercial. 




• Participarás activamente en presentaciones comerciales, con propuestas que aporten valor tanto al cliente como a la agencia. 




• Mantendrás el control y la organización de todos los aspectos operativos del día a día del cliente. 




 




Lo que buscamos en ti 




• Experiencia de 2 a 4 años gestionando cuentas y liderando proyectos con cliente en el entorno digital. 




• Don de gentes, capacidad para generar confianza y construir relaciones a largo plazo. 




• Perfil con olfato comercial, capaz de detectar oportunidades y convertirlas en propuestas concretas. 




• Capacidad para coordinar equipos, dar claridad y tomar decisiones. 




• Nivel alto de español e inglés. 




• Habilidad para analizar datos, detectar oportunidades y transformar problemas en soluciones. 




• Excelente comunicación, empatía y orientación al detalle. 




• Mentalidad estratégica, autonomía y foco en resultados. 




• Enfoque colaborativo, con ganas de sumar y hacer equipo. 




 




Formación y pluses que valoramos 




• Experiencia previa en agencia o entorno de marketing digital. 




• Conocimiento de ecommerce, estrategia de contenidos, data o medios digitales. 




• Conocimiento del Marketplace de Amazon, así como otros top Marketplaces mundiales. 




• Formación en publicidad, comunicación, ADE, marketing o similares. 




• Experiencia usando herramientas de reporting, gestión de proyectos o dashboards. 




 




En nuestro equipo compartimos estos valores: 




• People always come first → Las personas están siempre en el centro de nuestras decisiones. 




• We consider ourselves “builders” → Nos gusta construir, no solo ejecutar, siempre de la mano de nuestros partners. 




• Natives of the VUCA World → Sabemos movernos bien en entornos inciertos, nos gustan los retos. 




• Do what is right, not what is easy → Hacemos lo correcto, aunque cueste más. 




 




Qué ofrecemos 




• Contrato a jornada completa. 




• Proyecto estable, con impacto real desde el primer día. 




• Plan de crecimiento profesional y aprendizaje continuo. 




• Ambiente horizontal, exigente, colaborativo y con buen humor. 




• Retos continuos para seguir creciendo y creando nuevos proyectos. 




• Posibilidad de crecer dentro de una de las agencias más especializadas y en expansión del sector. 




 




Si te motiva un proyecto donde puedas liderar, proponer, aprender y crecer con tus cuentas, escríbenos a talent@amazingagency.io o aplica directamente. ¡Nos encantará conocerte!

Get On Board for a Dynamic and Purposeful Career

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Customer Service Executive to join our dynamic team at PIL in México. Our Customer Service Executive would handle customers contracts and be a focal point for sales subject to all other departments directing peripheral sales activities to the appropriate person.The successful candidate will play a crucial role in driving revenue growth by acquiring new customers, maintaining existing relationships, and expanding the company’s market share in the shipping and logistics industry.

Key Responsibilities


Download and treat daily booking requests, to be sent to customers within the next period
Handle all customer's demand to ensure all requests are promptly attended
System accuracy: Ensure routes, weight, POL/PODs, commodities, temperature and all other info are accurate on PIL system
Maintaining a good communication with other teams like Documentation and Sales Teams
Booking amendments and maintenance
File customers particularities to ensure a consistency on PIL service
Follow up bookings from regular / BID customers’, to ensure they are coming within the expected timeframe
Phone Attendance proving an excellent customer experience
Customer Attendance / Satisfaction. Acts on the extra mile aiming for Customer Excellence
Assist customer with problem solving
Liaise with internal departments to resolve customer grievances
Ensure adherence to Pocket PIL, selling this tool to customers in order to migrate the volume from other platforms


Qualifications & Experience


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, or related field.
Experience in customer service within the shipping or logistics industry.
Knowledge of import/export processes and documentation is essential.
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills.


Must Have


Experience in customer service within the shipping or logistics industry.
Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Proficiency in MS Office and CRM software.
Essential for dealing with international clients and understanding technical documents. Preferably B1, B2, or higher level in Speaking, Listening & Reading.


We Value


Customer-first mindset with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills
Detail-oriented with strong organizational abilities
Ability to multitask and perform under pressure in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
Proactive and solutions-oriented approach to challenges
Team player with a collaborative attitude, able to work effectively with diverse groups
Familiarity with shipping and logistics software
Adaptability and a commitment to continuous improvement


Why Join Us


Be part of a leading global carrier with a strong focus on sustainability and innovation.
Work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.


Application Process

To apply for this exciting opportunity, please submit your resume in English outlining your qualifications and experience to PIL Career Website .

Eligibility to Apply

This position is open to Mexican nationals or individuals with legal rights to work in Mexico. Applicants without the necessary work authorization will not be considered.

About Us

Incorporated in 1967, Pacific International Lines (PIL) is ranked 12th among the world’s top container shipping lines and is also the largest home-grown carrier in Southeast Asia. Based in Singapore, PIL is a global carrier with a focus on Asia, China, Africa, the Middle East, Latin America, Oceania, and the Pacific Islands.

Together with its affiliated companies Mariana Express Lines (MELL) and Malaysia Shipping Corporation, PIL serves customers at over 500 locations in more than 90 countries worldwide with a fleet of 100 container and multi-purpose vessels.

Apart from the core liner shipping business, PIL also has several other business units such as container manufacturing, depot, and logistics services.

PIL strives to meet the needs of its customers by providing value-adding services such as intermodal, breakbulk, and reefer services delivered on innovative technological platforms. With its focus on “Driving Connectivity” and commitment to achieving Net Zero by 2050, PIL aims to be an efficient, sustainable, and future-ready shipping line.

For more information, visit www.pilship.com
